title: Alignment Services & Plans Service Terms — Alignments Performed Under a Holding
content:
### Article 1 — Alignments under the plan
An alignment on a plan vehicle is performed and priced under the plan of Alignment Services & Plans.

### Article 2 — Plan in force
The plan must be in status active when an alignment is performed under it. The plan's own system record decides this, for the plan the alignment is performed under.

### Article 3 — Plan term
The alignment must be performed no later than the end of the plan term counted from the purchase of the plan. The clock starts on the plan's recorded purchase date; the term is the line's term in months. Months are counted as calendar months from the anchor date to the same day of the month, falling back to the last day of that month when that day does not exist. An alignment performed on the last day of the term is within it. Lifetime plans have no term end and run while the purchaser owns the vehicle.

### Article 4 — Single services
A single service includes only its purchase-day alignment; any later alignment on it is charged the line's member early-alignment price.

### Article 5 — Included and member-early alignments on a plan — no longer in force
The clause that an alignment on a plan is booked as included in the plan, with a labor charge of 0.00, when the interval measured from the last interval alignment has been reached (whichever of the month and mile intervals comes first) or when it is the purchase-day alignment, and that before the interval is reached it is charged the line's member early-alignment price as a member-early-price alignment that restarts the interval on lines where such an alignment counts toward the interval, is no longer in force; it has been superseded by the current basis for pricing plan alignments.

### Article 6 — Alignment types
Only an alignment type the line includes is performed under the holding.

### Article 7 — Inspection
When the pre-alignment inspection finds worn steering or suspension parts, the alignment is not performed until they are repaired, and the visit uses nothing.

### Article 8 — Parts charge — no longer in force
The clause that the parts charge of a work order carries any of the line's separately charged adjustment parts the vehicle needed, plus the line's steering angle sensor reset charge, plus the line's recalibration charge when the vehicle requires a recalibration, is no longer in force; it has been superseded by the current basis for pricing work-order parts.

### Term boundary cases (hypothetical dates)
| Plan | Alignment date | Within Article 3? |
|---|---|---|
| 12-month term, bought 15 May | 15 May of the following year | Yes — the last day of the term |
| 12-month term, bought 15 May | 16 May of the following year | No — the day after |
| 6-month term, bought 31 August | the last day of February | Yes — no 31 February exists, so the term ends on the last day of that month |
| lifetime plan | any date while the purchaser owns the vehicle | no term end applies |

superseded_clauses: On a plan the alignment is plan_included, with charge_amount 0.00, when alignment_msr_interval_reached is true (interval_basis whichever_comes_first) or it is the purchase-day alignment; before the interval is reached it is charged member_early_alignment_price as member_early_price, which restarts the interval when early_price_counts_as_interval is true.
parts_charge carries any of parts_charged_list the vehicle needed, plus steering_angle_reset_charge, plus adas_recalibration_charge when the vehicle requires a recalibration.
